answer: Use an arrival-gap consistency gate: score each identity’s request timing against a rolling delta from its own history, then throttle and quarantine accounts whose inter-arrival variance leaves that band. Clones must mimic both the slow baseline and busy zenith of real traffic, so each one burns compute and queue-wait to sustain plausible gaps. A raven flag for silent repeat patterns forces the attacker to pay for jittered scheduling across every identity.
